# A wait for a fact that the run never writes fails when the run ends, with the status of the run in its text. It does not run to its bound.
# The negated wait passes only when it fails on the end of the run with the status; a wait that runs to the bound fails the script.
exec beehest run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
! waitfile never-written
wait

exec beehest status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\t'

-- verdicts --
approve
approve
